Train VQ-VAE with Clustering

Source: R/MMD_Vae.R
trainVQVAEClustering.Rd

Trains a Vector Quantized Variational Autoencoder where codebook entries serve as learned cell type prototypes. Compatible with encodeSWAE/decodeSWAE.

Usage

trainVQVAEClustering(
  trainData,
  useMarkers,
  nClusters = 10L,
  pseudoLabels = NULL,
  epochs = 100L,
  latentDim = 16L,
  beta = 0.25,
  lambdaCluster = 1,
  batchSize = 64L,
  learningRate = 0.001,
  hiddenSizes = c(23L, 19L),
  clusterWarmup = 20L,
  labelSmoothing = 0,
  dropout = 0,
  useBatchNorm = FALSE,
  useLayerNorm = FALSE,
  weightDecay = 0,
  codebookReset = TRUE,
  resetInterval = 10L,
  softQuantize = FALSE,
  temperature = 1,
  skipVQDecode = FALSE,
  useEMA = FALSE,
  emaDecay = 0.99,
  useSkipConnections = FALSE,
  reconWeights = NULL,
  adversarial = FALSE,
  adversarialLambda = 1,
  sampleLabels = NULL,
  verbose = 1L,
  seed = 1994
)

Arguments

trainData

Data frame containing training data.

useMarkers

Character vector of marker column names.

nClusters

Integer, number of codebook entries / clusters.

pseudoLabels

Optional factor of pseudo-labels for supervised fine-tuning.

epochs

Integer, total training epochs.

latentDim

Integer, latent / codebook vector dimension.

beta

Numeric, commitment loss weight (default 0.25).

lambdaCluster

Numeric, supervised cluster loss weight.

batchSize

Integer, training batch size.

learningRate

Numeric, Adam learning rate.

hiddenSizes

Integer vector of length 2 for hidden layer sizes.

clusterWarmup

Integer, unsupervised VQ-VAE epochs before adding cluster loss.

labelSmoothing

Numeric, label smoothing for supervised loss.

dropout

Numeric, dropout rate.

useBatchNorm

Logical, use batch normalization.

useLayerNorm

Logical, use layer normalization.

weightDecay

Numeric, weight decay for AdamW.

codebookReset

Logical, reset unused codebook entries periodically.

resetInterval

Integer, how often (epochs) to check for dead codes.

verbose

Integer, verbosity level.

seed

Integer, random seed.

Value

List with encoder, decoder, clusterHead, codebook, history, metadata.
